historical_production_context.note: different evaluation protocol and dataset (100k-row current dataset, ungrouped); NOT directly equivalent to grouped Phase 7I metrics; no 'X% better' claim is made

decision_rationale: Evaluation is leakage-safe (grouped by unique symptom vector; 5 folds x 10 repeats of StratifiedGroupKFold) and fully reproducible.

All six model configs (logistic regression, linear SVM, random forest; class_weight None and balanced) reach essentially perfect grouped performance while the majority-class baseline is 0.033 accuracy / 0.024 balanced accuracy.
Five of six configs tie exactly at macro F1 = 1.0 with zero variance, so the evidence does not justify selecting one single experimental model (NO_CLEAR_WINNER per model-selection rule).

Near-ceiling scores are expected and partially reflect the dataset's canonical, noiseless symptom signatures (5-10 unique vectors per class, avg vector cosine ~0.106), NOT real-world patient variability.
304 unique associations are not 304 patients; generalization to real patient input variability remains unproven.
Production comparison uses a different protocol, so no superiority claim over the old production model is made.
DO NOT integrate: Phase 7J must separately perform backend integration validation.

recommendations.integration: Do not deploy the experimental model
next_steps: If Phase 7J proceeds, validate feature-order/inference compatibility and exact vector matching semantics first.
Retain 131-feature vocabulary; do not apply the 11 PENDING_CLINICIAN_REVIEW synonym mappings.
Expect performance on real patient variability to be lower than grouped-CV ceilings.

disclaimer: Non-clinical research/educational evaluation; not clinically validated. This model must not be used as a medical diagnosis system.
